formulations.Polymer system Notes: High purity PEO (HP-PEO) with MW ≈ 1×10⁶, synthesized using an anionic initiator.
formulations.Notes: The HP-PEO-based electrolytes are not thermodynamically stable at the reducing potential of metallic lithium. The passivating film characteristics are more dependent on the lithium salt purity than on that of the polymer.
